{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure we have the correct column names
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the correct column names
print('Column names:', trial_df.columns.tolist())

# The treatment arm is labeled as 'arm', not 'treatment'
# Check unique values in the 'arm' column
print('\nUnique values in arm column:', trial_df['arm'].unique())

# Check the response column
print('\nUnique values in responded column:', trial_df['responded'].unique())
print('\nMissing values in responded column:', trial_df['responded'].isnull().sum())

# Check the biomarker columns
print('\nBiomarker baseline - min/max:', trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].min(), trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].max())
print('Biomarker final - min/max:', trial_df['biomarker_final'].min(), trial_df['biomarker_final'].max())

# Compute change in biomarker
trial_df['biomarker_change'] = trial_df['biomarker_final'] - trial_df['biomarker_baseline']

# Group by arm and compute mean change and response rate
biomarker_change_by_arm = trial_df.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].agg(['mean', 'std', 'count'])
response_rate_by_arm = trial_df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()

print('\nChange in biomarker by arm:\n', biomarker_change_by_arm)
print('\nResponse rate by arm:\n', response_rate_by_arm)"}
